title: A Frog Fungus Wiped Out 90 Species
hook: One frog fungus erased 90 species, and recovery remains rare.
closing: Frog losses weaken ecosystems that depend on amphibians for balance.
question: Could these frog species recover?

segments.say: The fungus erased 90 amphibian species. A single disease turned rare extinctions into a mass loss.
Another 39% of affected species are still declining. The extinction wave has not ended.
The fungus hit 40 Australian frog species. Even isolated ecosystems could not escape it.
